description: Places the framework's session rules, `hooks/rules.md`, into every session at start and into every subagent at spawn of a project that declares `siegard.json`, and the drift a project is already carrying into every session at start; answers every stop of a session whose project holds a goal armed by `bin/goal.py --arm` from that goal's state, and, in a project that holds none, first holds the stop to the obligations a grant armed by `bin/grant.py --arm` left — what its answer at a render bound the session to, which `hooks/after_tool.py` records after `Bash`, `Skill` and `Agent` calls beside the instant a skill whose run ends on a render was invoked — then records the message a session stops on against what `bin/handoff.py --check` decides, and blocks once, with the next stop allowed, a turn that invoked such a skill and kept no render, only where `SIEGARD_HANDOFF_STOP` is `enforce`; and refuses a commit that adds to an orchestration log a `decided:` or `recommended:` line out of the form the handoff states, or a judged `decided:` line no armed goal granted, or that records a stop alongside more than the log and the telemetry root; and, through `hooks/bounds.py`, refuses a push, a branch, a history rewrite, a stash or a commit of all that is tracked while a goal or a grant is armed, and a hand write of `siegard-trace.json`, an initiative's `plan.json` or `delivery.json`, or a captured run, in every state.
